glaze_ui.blocker: Glaze UI 1.5.1 source adoption is present, but representative browser/OS accessibility, large-text/reflow, responsive task continuity, application performance, visual review, rollback, governed consumer-registry, and production acceptance remain required.

wardveil_security.blocker: Monitor has an explicit fail-closed Wardveil adoption contract over its existing source-validated security implementation. Target-runtime Wardveil/security acceptance remains required and production_approved remains false.

privacy_shield.blocker: Monitor declares a source-side draft Privacy Shield adapter limited to telemetry-minimization, data-minimization, retention-controls, and portable-export. Runtime acceptance and central Privacy Shield adapter acceptance remain required, and production_approved remains false.

everkeep.blocker: Monitor declares an Everkeep adoption and fail-closed acceptance-policy candidate bound to the canonical Everkeep acceptance schema. Target-native database restore, recovery freshness, live rollback, and exact-revision Everkeep acceptance remain required before integration or readiness can be asserted.

manager.blocker: Accepted GoreeCloud Manager operational visibility and administrative integration are not established.

goreecloud_mesh.blocker: Mesh registration, capabilities, event contracts, dependencies, and runtime acceptance are not established.

goreecloud_identity.blocker: Monitor has local Django authentication but accepted GoreeCloud Identity integration is not established.

goreecloud_policy.blocker: Accepted GoreeCloud Policy decision provenance, enforcement coordination, and runtime integration are not established.

goreecloud_observability.blocker: Monitor has application-local logging/monitoring evidence, but accepted GoreeCloud Observability integration is not established.

production_blockers: Glaze UI 1.5.1 browser/OS accessibility, responsive task-continuity, application-performance, visual-review, rollback, consumer-registry, and production acceptance
Privacy Shield runtime and central adapter acceptance
Everkeep target-native restore, recovery freshness, live rollback, and exact-revision acceptance
target database-native backup and isolated restore proof
reviewed live monitor activation and representative HTTP/HTTPS, TCP, TLS, DNS, heartbeat, Ping/ICMP, maintenance, incident, and notification acceptance
end-to-end GoreeCloud Notify delivery including durable-outbox restart/replay acceptance
